stories.title: 77th Republic Day 2026 celebrated on Jan 26
stories.body: chief guests were EU leaders Ursula von der Leyen (European Commission President) and António Costa (European Council President); theme "150 Years of Vande Mataram"; first parade after Operation Sindoor; ~10,000 special guests and free Delhi Metro travel.
